summary: This function searches for references to an environment variable name across multiple file types (config files, YAML, shell scripts, PHP, and Python) using the ripgrep tool. It's a convenience wrapper that enforces you provide a variable name and pre-configures the search to look in the right places without you having to remember all the file types each time.

explanations.3: This stores the first argument (the variable name you're searching for) in a local variable so we can use it later.
explanations.5: This checks if the variable is empty—meaning the user didn't provide a name to search for.
explanations.11: This tells ripgrep to treat files ending in .env, .cfg, .ini, or .conf as a new file type called 'config' so it knows to search inside them.
